coordinates._comment: The X/Z and Y controls (after the 1.7.10 console): each slot's range; a slot's value counts times x base^(the power slot's value + 1) when it has a power slot, else times. Y adds y_offset.

time._comment: The target-time controls: 'digits' number drums (0-9, first is highest) counted in a unit picked on the unit dial (ticks per unit; 1200 = a real minute, 24000 = a Minecraft day). The time lever picks 'ago' or 'from the beginning of time'. The unit dial model has 4 notches.

flight._comment: The loose box (free flight): gravity per tick with the thrusters off, drag in the air, ground friction, how much motion the thrusters keep per tick while hovering, and how far round the box turning it back into a block may set down.

piloting._comment: Flying the box with the flight yoke: acceleration and top speed across (blocks per tick), up/down speed (Q/E), sprint boost (times the top speed), and how fast the model spins while flown (degrees per tick, for show).

shock._comment: The electric shock when the loose box is hit (debris, the vortex wall, an attack): how many ticks the lightning crawls over it, how hard it is knocked away (blocks per tick), how far it rocks (degrees, dying away), and how many arcs hug it at once.

vortex._comment: Flying through the time vortex when a crew member pulls the dematerialisation lever: drift speed along the tunnel (blocks/tick), how far from the axis the box can go, tunnel length = min_length + length_per_block x hop distance (or jump_length for another dimension), capped at max_length; an obstacle clump every obstacle_gap blocks, up to obstacle_size across; a hit costs hit_charge. damage: the TARDIS's health, kept between trips: the most it can have is health plus the hull's health stat (subsystem/hull.json levels); debris and wall hits cost health, and each point lost adds drift_per_damage blocks of inaccuracy (how far off the course line it lands). At 0 health it crash lands at that point of the course: crash_height blocks up, thrusters off, flying down at crash_speed, with an explosion of power crater when it hits (0 = no crater), and is left with after_crash health. Repairing the hull fills it up; /tardis health sets it. enabled false = trips land at once. bend: how much the tunnel winds and turns (1 = the usual bends, 0 = straight, 1.5 = wilder).
